Designation: Kit de reparación REMA TIP TOP TT11
HtmlDescription:
This kit is ideal for a quick and durable repair of inner tubes, thanks to a quick drying time of the vulcanizing SVS sollution. Includes :

 

  • 6 Ø25mm Patches
  • 1 50x25mm Patch
  • 1 emery cloth rasp
  • 1 tube of 5g of vulcanizing liquid

 

Operation :

 

  • Locate the zone to repair
  • Use the rasp on this zone
  • Apply the SVS Vulcanizing Liquid on the zone, in thin layers
  • Thanks to the other side of the rasp (rubber side), spread the liquid until he gets a bit bright
  • Remove the patch protection, let it on the repair zone and press strongly
  • Remove the transparent protection, done !
